raw.rationale: Eptifibatide is a highly polar cyclic heptapeptide that blocks the platelet integrin αIIbβ3 (ITGA2B/ITGB3) and is not expected to enter or kill adherent cancer cells at 2.5 µM; PRISM viability screens of such non-cytotoxic, non-permeable compounds typically show no lineage-selective killing. Although some tumor lineages can express ITGB3/ITGA2B-related integrins, eptifibatide's RGD-mimetic binding is highly αIIbβ3-selective and lacks evidence of lineage-specific anticancer activity.
